name: Machine Account Creation Request Completed
description: Sent to a requester to notify that their machine account create request has been completed successfully.
subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request completed successfully for $data.accountName
body:
Machine Account Creation Request Completed

Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to create the machine account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName has been completed successfully.

Machine account: $data.accountName

Source: $data.sourceName

The account is now active and ready for use. The account owner has been notified and can begin managing the account.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
